summary: V19 2FA (TOTP) backend + frontend smoke test. All 18 backend pytest cases PASSED (100%). Verified: login without 2FA returns token+trust_expires_at; /2fa/setup/start returns otpauth_uri + QR data URL + base32 secret; /2fa/setup/confirm rejects invalid code (400) and accepts valid TOTP returning 10 backup codes in XXXXX-XXXXX format; /2fa/status; login with 2FA on returns requires_2fa+temp_token (no token); /auth/login/2fa validates TOTP + backup codes; TOTP replay prevention works (same code twice -> 401); backup code single-use enforced (reuse -> 401); wrong TOTP -> 401; /2fa/regenerate-backup-codes with valid TOTP returns 10 fresh codes and invalidates old ones; /2fa/disable with password works and status flips to enabled:false. Frontend smoke: login screen renders correctly (Italian), plain login routes to /home, when 2FA is enabled the 2FA prompt view (`shield-checkmark` + code input + Verifica button) appears and shows 'Codice 2FA non valido' on wrong code. Owner test user cleaned up (2FA disabled) after tests.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — comes from a library (likely LinearGradient/Pressable ancestor). Non-blocking but should be tracked.

React Native error repeated ~13x on home screen load: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' — indicates stray whitespace/expression producing a raw text node inside a <View> (likely a conditional rendering pattern like {condition && ...}). Not related to 2FA but pollutes the console. Reference: home tab (not login/security).

action_items: (Optional) Investigate the 'Unexpected text node' console errors on the home tab — likely a bare `{some || ''}` or stray space in a JSX <View>. Search for `<View>` children that could produce empty text nodes.
(Optional) Replace deprecated `pointerEvents` prop usages with `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 526: TOTP detection uses `not code.isdigit() or len(code) >= 8` to try backup code first — works because backup codes are 11 chars with a dash. Acceptable.

server.py line 542: TOTP replay prevention only stores the LAST code (`totp_last_code`). A user could theoretically use two different valid codes from the same 30s window (with valid_window=1, three windows are accepted). Consider tracking multiple recent codes or the numeric timecode counter for stricter replay prevention. Not a blocker.

server.py: `TwoFADisableInput` allows disable via {code} (TOTP or backup) as an alternative to password. The spec says 'correct password' — this is a broader/looser policy but is intentional per the model. OK.
server.py file is now ~1750+ lines; consider splitting auth/2FA into its own module.
